clauses.STO-JUR-2026-J.1: In Corvane, every vehicle on a public road must carry liability insurance with these minimums: $25,000 for bodily injury to one person, $50,000 for all injuries in one accident and $20,000 for property damage.
clauses.STO-JUR-2026-J.2: An insurer that decides to cancel a policy must notify the policyholder at least twenty days in advance. When the reason is unpaid premium, the notice may be ten days.
clauses.STO-JUR-2026-J.3: Anyone who has an accident or a loss must report it to their insurer within the following sixty days, unless they show they could not do so sooner.
clauses.STO-JUR-2026-J.4: The driver must carry current proof of their insurance, on paper or in digital form, and show it when a traffic authority asks for it.
clauses.STO-JUR-2026-J.5: A lawsuit against an insurer over an auto policy must be filed within two years of the accident or loss.
clauses.STO-PAP-2025-A.EXCL.A.5.ALT: We do not cover liability that arises while the vehicle is carrying people or goods, whether for pay or not, including trips where acquaintances share the costs.
clauses.STO-PAP-2025-A.INS: Seguros Aburrá pays for the damage the insured causes with a covered auto, up to the limit of this part, but does not take on the insured's defense: lawyers' fees are paid by the insured.
clauses.STO-PAP-2025-C.INS.ALT: Seguros Aburrá pays the damages for bodily injury that you or a family member are entitled to claim from the driver of an uninsured vehicle, as long as that driver is identified. Accidents where the party at fault flees are not covered.
clauses.STO-PAP-2025-D.INS.COLLISION.ALT: Seguros Aburrá pays for direct damage to your covered auto from hitting something or rolling over, minus the collision deductible, only if the crash was caused by someone else.
clauses.STO-PAP-2025-D.TRANSPORT: If your covered auto is out of use because of a theft or a covered loss, we reimburse transportation expenses up to $12 a day and $360 in total, starting on the third day.
clauses.STO-PAP-2025-DEF.COVERED_AUTO: "Covered auto" means the vehicle listed on the declarations page. A vehicle bought during the policy period is covered only from the time it is added to the declarations page by an endorsement.
clauses.STO-PAP-2025-DEF.YOU.ALT: "You" means only the person listed as the primary insured on the declarations page; that person's spouse or partner is not included even when living with them.
clauses.STO-PAP-2025-E.DUTIES.A.1.ALT: Tell us about any accident or loss within the following thirty days; after that deadline, the notice is no longer accepted.
clauses.STO-PAP-2026-A.EXCL.A.1: There is no coverage for injury or damage the insured causes on purpose, or for injury or damage someone else causes following the insured's orders.
clauses.STO-PAP-2026-A.EXCL.A.2: We do not cover damage to property that belongs to the insured or that the insured is transporting.
clauses.STO-PAP-2026-A.EXCL.A.3: We do not cover damage to property the insured has rented, borrowed or in their care.
clauses.STO-PAP-2026-A.EXCL.A.4: We do not cover bodily injury to an employee of the insured that happens while the employee is working for the insured: those injuries are handled by the applicable workplace injury system.
clauses.STO-PAP-2026-A.EXCL.A.5: We do not cover liability that arises while the vehicle is carrying people or goods for pay, including trips booked through an app. Acquaintances sharing the costs of a trip is not considered pay.
clauses.STO-PAP-2026-A.EXCL.A.6: We do not cover the insured while using a vehicle as part of a business that sells, repairs, washes, parks or stores vehicles.
clauses.STO-PAP-2026-A.EXCL.A.7: We do not cover anyone who uses a vehicle without the owner's permission or without reasonable grounds to believe they had it.
clauses.STO-PAP-2026-A.EXCL.A.8: We do not cover accidents that happen during races, speed contests or performance tests, or during practice to take part in them.
clauses.STO-PAP-2026-A.EXCL.A.9: We do not pay fines, penalties, surcharges or damages that a judge imposes as punishment rather than as repair of the harm.
clauses.STO-PAP-2026-A.EXCL.B.1: There is no coverage while the insured is driving a motorcycle, a motorized tricycle or another two- or three-wheeled vehicle.
clauses.STO-PAP-2026-A.EXCL.B.2: We do not cover the use of a vehicle you own that is not listed on the declarations page, except the newly bought vehicle that the covered auto definition includes.
clauses.STO-PAP-2026-A.EXCL.B.3: We do not cover the use of a vehicle that a family member owns, or that a family member regularly has available, if that vehicle is not listed on the declarations page.
clauses.STO-PAP-2026-A.FIN_RESP: When a Corvane authority asks for proof that the driver carries liability insurance, this policy serves as that proof, with at least the minimums set in the jurisdiction document.
clauses.STO-PAP-2026-A.INS: If an accident with a covered auto or a substitute vehicle makes the insured answerable to someone else for bodily injury or property damage, Seguros Aburrá pays those damages up to the limit of this part. We also take on the insured's defense against those claims, with lawyers we choose, and we may reach a settlement when we consider it appropriate. We stop defending the insured once what has been paid under this part reaches its limit.
clauses.STO-PAP-2026-A.LIMIT: The per-person limit shown on the declarations page is the most we pay for bodily injury to any one person in an accident. The per-accident limit is the most for all injuries in that accident, and the property damage limit is the most for all damaged property. These limits do not increase because there are more insureds, more vehicles or more claims.
clauses.STO-PAP-2026-A.OTHER: If another liability policy also responds to the accident, we split the payment in proportion to each policy's limits. When the vehicle is not yours, that vehicle's insurance pays first and we cover what remains.
clauses.STO-PAP-2026-A.OUT_OF_STATE: If the accident happens outside Corvane and the law of that place requires higher minimum limits than this policy's, we apply those minimums to that accident. We never pay twice for the same damage.
clauses.STO-PAP-2026-A.SUPP: In addition to the limit of this part, Seguros Aburrá pays the defense costs, the cost of court bonds required of the insured because of a covered accident and the reasonable expenses the insured incurs when we ask for help with the case, including travel to hearings.
clauses.STO-PAP-2026-AGREEMENT.1: Seguros Aburrá agrees to protect the insured on the terms of this contract. The protection covers the events described in each part of the policy when they happen in the territory set out in Part F.
clauses.STO-PAP-2026-AGREEMENT.2: The protection runs during the period shown on the policy's declarations page. To keep it in force, the insured meets the duties this contract assigns, especially those in Part E.
clauses.STO-PAP-2026-B.EXCL.1: We do not pay medical expenses for injuries suffered on a motorcycle or another two- or three-wheeled vehicle.
clauses.STO-PAP-2026-B.EXCL.2: We do not pay medical expenses for injuries suffered while the vehicle is carrying passengers for pay.
clauses.STO-PAP-2026-B.EXCL.3: We do not pay medical expenses for injuries that happen while the vehicle was being used as a home or as a fixed workplace.
clauses.STO-PAP-2026-B.EXCL.4: We do not pay medical expenses for injuries suffered in races, speed contests or performance tests.
clauses.STO-PAP-2026-B.INS: Seguros Aburrá pays reasonable medical and funeral expenses that result from a traffic accident and are incurred within the following two years. We cover you and your family members when they are riding in a vehicle or are struck by one, and anyone else while occupying your covered auto.
clauses.STO-PAP-2026-B.LIMIT: The per-person limit shown on the declarations page is the most we pay for the medical expenses of each injured person in one accident, however many people or vehicles are involved.
clauses.STO-PAP-2026-B.OTHER: If another medical expense policy covers the same expenses, we pay only what remains unpaid after that policy, up to our limit.
clauses.STO-PAP-2026-C.ARBITRATION: If we and the insured disagree about whether the insured is entitled to damages or about the amount, either of us may ask for the question to be decided by an arbitrator in Corvane. Each side pays its own costs and half of the arbitrator's fees.
clauses.STO-PAP-2026-C.EXCL.1: We do not cover injuries to anyone riding in a vehicle owned by you or a family member that is not insured under this policy.
clauses.STO-PAP-2026-C.EXCL.2: We do not cover a claim the insured settled with the at-fault party or its insurer without our written consent.
clauses.STO-PAP-2026-C.EXCL.3: There is no coverage while the vehicle is carrying people or goods for pay.
clauses.STO-PAP-2026-C.EXCL.4: We do not cover anyone who uses a vehicle without the owner's permission or without reasonable grounds to believe they had it.
clauses.STO-PAP-2026-C.INS: Seguros Aburrá pays the damages for bodily injury that you or a family member are entitled to claim from the driver or owner of an uninsured vehicle. We also cover the case where the vehicle at fault flees and neither its driver nor its owner can be identified, as long as the event was reported to the police.
clauses.STO-PAP-2026-C.LIMIT: The most we pay under this part is the uninsured motorist limit shown on the declarations page, per person and per accident, however many vehicles or people are involved. Anything the at-fault party has already paid is subtracted.
clauses.STO-PAP-2026-C.OTHER: If several policies cover the same person for the same accident, we split the payment in proportion to each one's limits.
clauses.STO-PAP-2026-D.APPRAISAL: If we and you disagree on the amount of the loss, each of us names an appraiser and the two appraisers choose a third. What two of the three agree on is binding on both of us. Each of us pays our own appraiser and half of the third.
clauses.STO-PAP-2026-D.EXCL.1: We do not cover damage that happens while the vehicle is carrying people or goods for pay.
clauses.STO-PAP-2026-D.EXCL.10: We do not cover damage that you or a family member cause to the vehicle on purpose.
clauses.STO-PAP-2026-D.EXCL.11: We do not cover damage caused by carrying more weight in the vehicle than its manufacturer allows.
clauses.STO-PAP-2026-D.EXCL.12: We do not cover theft if the vehicle was left unlocked with the keys inside or with the engine running in a public place.
clauses.STO-PAP-2026-D.EXCL.13: We do not cover flood damage if the driver entered a road that the authorities had closed or marked as flooded.
clauses.STO-PAP-2026-D.EXCL.2: We do not cover wear from use, rust, mechanical or electrical failures, or damage from freezing, unless they result from a theft or another covered loss.
clauses.STO-PAP-2026-D.EXCL.3: We do not cover sound systems, screens, navigation units or other electronic equipment that was not installed at the factory.
clauses.STO-PAP-2026-D.EXCL.4: We do not cover personal belongings inside the vehicle, such as clothing, tools, money or phones.
clauses.STO-PAP-2026-D.EXCL.5: We do not cover damage limited to the tires, such as punctures or blowouts, unless it comes from a fire, a theft or an act of vandalism.
clauses.STO-PAP-2026-D.EXCL.6: We do not cover loss of the vehicle through seizure, impoundment or destruction ordered by an authority.
clauses.STO-PAP-2026-D.EXCL.7: We do not cover damage caused by war, rebellion, organized terrorism or nuclear energy.
clauses.STO-PAP-2026-D.EXCL.8: We do not cover damage suffered in races, speed contests or performance tests, or in practice for them.
clauses.STO-PAP-2026-D.EXCL.9: We do not cover parts, accessories or modifications added to the vehicle without being declared, such as custom wheels, modified suspensions or engine upgrades.
clauses.STO-PAP-2026-D.INS.COLLISION: Seguros Aburrá pays for direct and accidental damage to your covered auto from hitting another vehicle or object or from rolling over, minus the collision deductible shown on the declarations page. We pay even if you caused the crash.
clauses.STO-PAP-2026-D.INS.OTC: We also pay, minus the corresponding deductible, for damage to your covered auto that does not come from a crash: theft of the vehicle or its parts, fire, flood, hail, falling objects, vandalism, broken glass and hitting animals.
clauses.STO-PAP-2026-D.LIMIT: The most we pay for a loss is the lower of the vehicle's market value at the time of the damage and the cost of repairing it or of replacing stolen parts with equivalent ones.
clauses.STO-PAP-2026-D.NO_BAILEE: This coverage does not benefit anyone who has the vehicle in their charge as a business, such as a repair shop, a parking lot or a vehicle transport company: if they cause the damage, we may recover it from them.
clauses.STO-PAP-2026-D.OTHER_SOURCES: If another policy or another source covers the same loss, we pay only our share, in proportion to our limit against the total.
clauses.STO-PAP-2026-D.PAYMENT: We decide whether to pay the loss in money or to take charge of the repair or replacement. If we pay a total loss, the vehicle or its remains become ours. If we recover a stolen vehicle, we return it to you and pay for any damage it suffered.
clauses.STO-PAP-2026-D.TRANSPORT: If your covered auto is out of use because of a theft or a covered loss, we reimburse the transportation expenses you pay in the meantime, up to $18 a day and $540 in total. Reimbursement counts from the day after the theft or damage.
clauses.STO-PAP-2026-DEF.BODILY_INJURY: "Bodily injury" means any harm to a person's health caused by the accident: wounds, illness that results from them and, when it happens, death.
clauses.STO-PAP-2026-DEF.COVERED_AUTO: "Covered auto" means the vehicle listed on the declarations page and the trailer listed there. It also means a vehicle you buy during the policy period, if you tell us about it within ten days of receiving it.
clauses.STO-PAP-2026-DEF.FAMILY_MEMBER: "Family member" means a person who lives in your home and is related to you by blood, by marriage or union, or by adoption, including children in your legal care.
clauses.STO-PAP-2026-DEF.OCCUPYING: "Occupant" means anyone who is inside the vehicle or getting in or out of it. It also means anyone standing next to the vehicle while loading it or pushing it by hand.
clauses.STO-PAP-2026-DEF.PROPERTY_DAMAGE: "Property damage" means breaking, destroying or making unusable an object that can be touched, such as a vehicle, a fence or a building front, when it belongs to someone else.
clauses.STO-PAP-2026-DEF.TEMPORARY_SUBSTITUTE: "Substitute vehicle" means a vehicle you drive temporarily, without owning it, while your covered auto is out of use because of repair, breakdown, theft or total loss. For as long as that situation lasts, it receives the same protection as the covered auto.
clauses.STO-PAP-2026-DEF.TRAILER: "Trailer" means a vehicle without its own engine designed to be hitched to a private passenger car, such as a light cargo trailer or a small camper.
clauses.STO-PAP-2026-DEF.WE: "We" means Seguros Aburrá, the insurer that issues this contract and stands behind it.
clauses.STO-PAP-2026-DEF.YOU: "You" means the person listed as the primary insured on the declarations page. It also means the person who shares a life as a couple and a home with them, for as long as they keep living together.
clauses.STO-PAP-2026-E.DUTIES.A.1: Tell us about any accident or loss as soon as possible and always within the deadline set in the Corvane jurisdiction document.
clauses.STO-PAP-2026-E.DUTIES.A.2: Tell us how, when and where it happened, and which vehicles and people were involved.
clauses.STO-PAP-2026-E.DUTIES.A.3: Give us the name and one contact detail of the injured people and of the witnesses you know of.
clauses.STO-PAP-2026-E.DUTIES.B.1: Cooperate with us in reviewing the case and in defending any claim against you.
clauses.STO-PAP-2026-E.DUTIES.B.2: Send us right away a copy of any notice, summons or lawsuit you receive about the accident.
clauses.STO-PAP-2026-E.DUTIES.B.3: If the claim involves injuries, attend the medical exams we ask for, with doctors we pay for, as often as is reasonable.
clauses.STO-PAP-2026-E.DUTIES.B.4: Authorize us to obtain your medical records and the other documents about the injuries, and give us a written account of the loss if we ask for it.
clauses.STO-PAP-2026-E.DUTIES.C.1: If the party at fault fled without identifying themselves, report it to the police within the following 24 hours.
clauses.STO-PAP-2026-E.DUTIES.C.2: If you sue an uninsured driver, send us a copy of the lawsuit and of what you receive in that case.
clauses.STO-PAP-2026-E.DUTIES.D.1: Take reasonable steps to keep the vehicle from further damage; we pay you back what you spend on them.
clauses.STO-PAP-2026-E.DUTIES.D.2: If the vehicle or any of its parts was stolen, report it to the police immediately.
clauses.STO-PAP-2026-E.DUTIES.D.3: Let us see and appraise the vehicle before you repair it or get rid of it.
clauses.STO-PAP-2026-END-1-DEF.FAMILY_MEMBER: For this policy, a family member also includes your son or daughter under 25 who studies in another city and lives there during the period of study, even if they do not live in your home.
clauses.STO-PAP-2026-END-2-A.EXCL.A.5: The exclusion for transporting people or goods for pay does not apply while the covered auto is providing service through a ride platform registered in Corvane, from the moment the driver accepts the trip until the passenger gets out. The same Part A limits apply.
clauses.STO-PAP-2026-END-3-D.EXCL.3: The exclusion for electronic equipment not installed at the factory does not apply to equipment you have declared with its invoice, up to $1,500 per loss and with the deductible for damage that does not come from a crash.
clauses.STO-PAP-2026-END-4-C.ARBITRATION: Arbitration under Part C is decided by a panel of three arbitrators: one named by each side and the third chosen by the first two. Each side pays its own arbitrator and half of the third.
clauses.STO-PAP-2026-END-5-F.PERIOD_TERRITORY: The policy territory is extended to trips of up to 30 consecutive days through the jurisdictions neighboring Corvane, as long as the covered auto returns to Corvane at the end of the trip.
clauses.STO-PAP-2026-F.BANKRUPTCY: If the insured goes bankrupt or becomes insolvent, Seguros Aburrá still answers for what this policy covers.
clauses.STO-PAP-2026-F.CHANGES: This contract changes only in writing, through an endorsement we issue. If a change you request alters the risk, we adjust the premium from the date of the change.
clauses.STO-PAP-2026-F.FRAUD: We give no coverage to anyone who knowingly lied about or hid an important fact about the accident, the loss or the information they gave us when taking out the policy.
clauses.STO-PAP-2026-F.LEGAL_ACTION: No one may sue us over this policy without first meeting the duties it imposes, and the suit must be filed within the deadline set in the Corvane jurisdiction document.
clauses.STO-PAP-2026-F.PERIOD_TERRITORY: The policy covers accidents and losses that happen during the period shown on the declarations page and within the territory of Corvane.
clauses.STO-PAP-2026-F.RECOVERY: When we pay for harm that someone else caused, we may collect what we paid from that person in place of the insured. The insured helps us do so and does nothing to undermine that recovery.
clauses.STO-PAP-2026-F.TERMINATION: You may cancel the policy at any time by telling us in writing. We may cancel it only with the advance notice required by the Corvane jurisdiction document, and we refund the premium for the time that had not yet run.
clauses.STO-PAP-2026-F.TRANSFER: Your rights under this policy do not pass to anyone else without our written consent.
clauses.STO-PAP-2026-F.TWO_POLICIES: If two or more Seguros Aburrá policies cover the same accident, the most we pay is the highest limit of any single one of them.

note: Reference translations: the text that governs is the original policy text.
